title: White facing right
alg: R U R' U'
rec: Turn the top until the corner sits above the slot it belongs in, between its two colours. Hold that slot at the front-right. White facing right: do the moves once.

title: White facing up
alg: R U R' U'
rec: Same moves, done three times. If a white corner is in the bottom layer but in the wrong place or twisted, do the moves once to bring it up to the top.

title: White facing front
alg: R U R' U'
rec: Same moves, done five times. Whichever way the corner is turned, keep repeating until it drops in solved.

title: Edge goes right
alg: U R U' R' U' F' U F
rec: Find a top edge with no yellow. Turn the top until its front colour matches the centre below it. Its top colour matches the right centre, so it goes right.

title: Edge goes left
alg: U' L' U L U F U' F'
rec: The mirror image: the top colour matches the left centre. If an edge is stuck in the middle layer the wrong way round, insert any top edge into its slot to push it out.
